description: Get the complete record for one dart game by slug: objective, setup, rules, scoring, winning, variations, tips, equipment, and videos. Optionally narrow to specific sections. Includes the board the game is played on (boardType, boardLabel, boardUrl) and the dolfdarts.com URL.

sections.description: Optional: restrict content to these sections to save tokens. Core metadata is always included.

slug.description: Game slug, e.g. '501', 'standard-cricket', 'dolf'. Discover via search_games/list_games.

name: get_game
title: Get full dart game rules
